title: TweetBet
tagline: A decentralized prediction markets from tweets. Bet on viral posts.
description:
A decentralized prediction market platform built on Arc blockchain. Where users can create their favorite markets from Viral X posts, and earn yield income on every trade. 

Built with Next.js, Solidity, Circle wallets, and ENS domains, OpenAI, and deployed on the Arc blockchain.

Create Your Own Markets: Turn viral X posts into prediction markets
Earn Yield: Market creators and liquidity providers earn fees from trades
Gasless Experience: Passkey wallet creation and gasless transactions using Circle Wallets
Live Pricing: ERC-6909–based AMM with demand-driven pricing
Cross-Chain Liquidity: Use liquidity from multiple chains via Circle Gateway
Human-Readable Wallets: ENS names instead of 0x addresses
Fast & Cheap: Built on Arc for low-cost transactions
how_its_made:
1. Smart Contracts
    - ERC-6909–based contracts for creating prediction markets
    - AMM pricing using ERC-6909 and ERC-20 tokens
    - Tested with Foundry
    - Deployed on Arc testnet

2. Backend
    - Fetches viral X post data
    - OpenAI generates prediction questions
    - MongoDB stores market data

3. Frontend
    - Next.js 16 (App Router)
    - Wagmi + Viem for blockchain interactions
    - Circle Wallets for passkey onboarding
    - Tailwind CSS
